notes: Official Dunkin' Nutrition Guide (last updated 09-21-2026), linked from dunkindonuts.com/nutrition. Sizes are as Dunkin' labels them (small/medium/large/extra large); fluid ounces are not stated in the guide. Hot/packaged tea rows (listed with no nutritional values) are not included. Atwater outliers (kept as published): Shakin' Espresso with Sugar Free Vanilla and Almondmilk [medium] (70 cal vs Atwater 90); Shakin' Espresso with Sugar Free Vanilla and Almondmilk [small] (50 cal vs Atwater 70).
